author: Inside Edition
description: These lawn ornaments were all stolen. In 2024, iconic inflatable Santas lined the streets in Carlsbad, California. That was until a Grinch stole one. In 2019, there was a desperate search to find a life-size dinosaur, a staple of a Colorado community. In January of 2026, a Nebraska couple wanted help finding the Hamburglar taken from their lawn. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more.
title: Strange Stories About Stolen Lawn Ornaments

author: Inside Edition
description:
A man spotted something in a river in northwest Missouri. The man found a giant leg bone of a Columbian mammoth, a relative of the better known woolly mammoth that roamed Missouri more than 10,000 years ago. Hauling the massive object to shore, Jason Howery could not believe it. Howery says the bone is the discovery of his lifetime. He spoke to Inside Edition's Les Trent.


Howery set up a GoFundMe to support the documentation and preservation of the discovery. For further information about the GoFundMe, click this link: https://www.gofundme.com/f/preserve-a-mammoth-discovery-inspire-scientists
title: Missouri Man Discovers Mammoth Bone In River
